svg.title: Polarization-switched passive cavity dump path — OpticalSetup setup
svg.desc: Native pulse light enters a folded storage loop through a PBS. An electro-optic retarder changes polarization before return to the splitter; the upward output port samples the selected extraction path. The native setup demonstrates a switchable passive extraction geometry. It does not accumulate stored energy over repeated temporal round trips or calculate dump efficiency and timing jitter.
